Role Purpose

Oversees sales activities within assigned home pass areas, managing both door-to-door and sales partner channels. Focuses on achieving sales targets, including gross adds with good quality customers, and supports regional goals. Analyzes sales performance within the area to identify root causes of performance issues and develops and implements strategies to address these challenges. Ensures effective performance of team leaders and account executives, drives sales growth, and adapts strategies based on performance insights to improve overall results. Contributes to achieving net add goals through targeted actions and continuous performance evaluation.

Scope of Work

• Analyze market competitive landscape, trends and customer needs to inform sales tactics.
• Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve regional targets.
• Supervise and support the sales team, including team leaders and account executives.
• Conduct regular performance reviews and provide feedback.
• Foster a collaborative and high-performance sales culture
• Monitor and evaluate sales performance metrics.
• Identify root causes of performance issues and implement corrective actions.
• Maintain and strengthen relationships with key clients and partners.
• Oversee customer accounts and ensure high levels of customer satisfaction.
• Address client concerns and ensure high levels of customer satisfaction.
• Prepare and present sales reports to senior management.
• Document sales activities and maintain records in the CRM system.
• Maintain relationships with partners
• Negotiate contracts and agreements to secure favorable terms.
• Collaborate with partners to drive joint sales initiatives.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
• Professional certifications in sales or marketing are an advantage.
• Strong knowledge of sales principles and practices.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

About INDICO

INDICO is Telkomsel's subsidiary focusing on creating values in developing Indonesia's digital ecosystem. As a digital ecosystem enabler, INDICO plays a strategic role both as a platform company and a holding company.

As a platform company, INDICO strives to create non-telecom value by enhancing user experience of Telkomsel and INDICO Group services. Currently, INDICO is building three business platforms through a B2B2C model: INDICO Commerce (digital product transaction solution), INDICO Engage (marketing solution), and INDICO DataHub (data solution).

As a holding company, INDICO nurtures vertical businesses across sectors: Fita (health tech), Kuncie (edtech), Majamojo (game publishing), and Digital Food Ecosystem (agritech). By harnessing telecom's commercial and technological assets, INDICO aspires to create a new economy, empowering Indonesians and enabling businesses across sectors to advance Indonesia's digital economy.

INDICO believe we can reach beyond to empower Indonesians and enable businesses through our strong core values of EPIC WAY (Excellence, Positivity, Impactful Collaboration, Customer First, Walk the Talk, Accountability, Yes-if Mindset).

What you will do but not limited to:

• Organizing Digital Legal Documentation: Reorganize and standardize the structure of online document folders to improve accessibility and navigation.
• Sanitization of Sensitive Legal Documents: Redact personal and sensitive information (e.g., identity details) in company deeds.
• Legal Service Level Agreement (SLA) and Process Mind map: Assist in visualizing the legal process workflows through the creation of a legal SLA and mind map for internal guidance.
• Legal & Compliance Newsletter: Contribute to the development of a periodic internal newsletter containing regulatory updates, etc.
• Online Documentation Tracker: Develop and maintain a tracker to monitor deadlines, critical obligations, and document/contract validity periods.
• Compliance Monitoring Dashboard: Maintain a compliance tracker covering areas such as Intellectual Property (IP), Business Licensing (PB-UMKU), OSS submissions, and others.
• Business-as-Usual Legal Support: Provide assistance in reviewing contracts and agreements, particularly those using pre-approved templates.
• Legal and Regulatory Research: Conduct ad-hoc legal research, primarily focusing on compliance-related topics or regulatory inquiries as required by the department.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in law
• Proficient in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace
• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
• Solid research and writing ability in legal and regulatory contexts
• Familiarity with compliance areas such as Intellectual Property, OSS submissions, and business licensing (PB-UMKU) is a plus.
• Able to maintain confidentiality and work independently or in a team
• Eager to learn and contribute in a structured legal environment
